retrieval_scope: Production local hybrid retriever: Chroma vector search + BM25 + RRF, one original question per retrieval call, with production query ranking. No web or RAG context selector added.

ground_truth.candidate_discovery: Chroma vector query using evidence phrases; exact metadata source values are resolved through normalized source labels; global fallback used when the expected source is absent.

metric_definitions.precision_at_k: Relevant retrieved chunks in top K divided by K.
metric_definitions.recall_at_k: Relevant retrieved chunks in top K divided by all grade-2/3 judged relevant chunks in that question's evidence candidate pool.
metric_definitions.mrr: Reciprocal rank of first grade-2/3 chunk through rank 10.
metric_definitions.ndcg: Graded nDCG with gain 2^grade - 1; grades 1, 2 and 3 contribute.
metric_definitions.aggregation: Every dataset question appears in per_question_metrics. Precision, recall and MRR macro averages use questions with a completed review and at least one grade-2/3 chunk. Graded nDCG also includes completed questions with grade-1-only evidence. Questions with no candidates, only grade-0 labels, or incomplete judgments remain visible with an explicit status instead of being silently dropped.

answer_generation.note: Answer-only evaluation using the saved retrieval_results.json from the selected run; retrieval and relevance review were not rerun.
